item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Abiy’s government consistently responded to domestic flare-ups with protection and restraint instead of collective punishment, censorship, or militarized control.","evidence":[{"title":"Ethiopia authorities must stop using state of emergency law to silence peaceful dissent","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-19","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/ethiopia-authorities-must-stop-using-state-of-emergency-law-to-silence-peaceful-dissent/","summary":"Amnesty said the state of emergency was being used to silence peaceful dissent through warrantless arrests, curfews, movement limits, and bans on assemblies and associations. This is direct evidence that a domestic crisis response was using coercion and fear rather than protection and restraint.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.5","3B.6","3B.8"]},{"title":"World Report 2024: Ethiopia","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-12","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/ethiopia","summary":"HRW described the Amhara emergency as granting broad warrantless-arrest, curfew, assembly-ban, and search powers, and said security forces repeatedly arrested critics and journalists. That is strong evidence against a restrained response to internal flare-ups.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.5","3B.6","3B.8"]},{"title":"Ethiopia’s Deepening Crackdown on Dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-03-04","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/04/ethiopias-deepening-crackdown-dissent","summary":"HRW reported arbitrary arrests, forced disappearance of EHRCO staff, and an atmosphere in which “no one” appeared safe from arbitrary detention. This shows the crisis response was producing fear and retaliation rather than suppressing violence in a rights-respecting way.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.5","3B.6","3B.8","3B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia: Halt Crackdown Against Human Rights Groups","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-06-18","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/18/ethiopia-halt-crackdown-against-human-rights-groups","summary":"HRW said security and intelligence personnel followed, intimidated, and threatened human-rights workers at homes and offices. That is evidence of a chilling domestic security response, not a protective one.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.5","3B.6","3B.8","3B.1"]},{"title":"In Ethiopia, a secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels","publisher":"Reuters via EHRC","date":"2024-02-27","url":"https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/","summary":"The EHRC head confirmed a secret security committee that interfered in the justice system and was linked to widespread human-rights violations.
